---
title: "Core protein classes"
output: html_document
---

The 747 core proteins were grouped into six classes using mixed protein
annotations and consensus clustering. The supplied class assignments are the
labels used in the manuscript. This analysis reconstructs the Gower-distance
ordination, class sizes and class-level feature profiles from the 40 retained
features.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "05_core_classes.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/05_core_classes/core_class_counts.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

The ordination coordinates and figure are written to
`analysis/05_core_classes/`.
